intent: Implement IngressPacket making the T1 tests pass, exactly per ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. Anticorruption translation of an edge-device packet. Record IngressPacket(String deviceId, Instant ingressTimestamp, List<RawSample> samples) with nested record RawSample(TelemetrySample.MetricType metricType, double value, Instant deviceTimestamp). toSamples converts each RawSample into a TelemetrySample with status VALID (pending validation), recordId via TelemetrySample.recordIdFor, and the packet ingressTimestamp; device formats never leak. Samples list is defensively copied, non-empty, no nulls.
